data.title: 藤原千花 · 晚霞琴房的独奏侧颜
data.description: 秀知院音乐教室被斜照的金色晚霞染透，琴键上跃动着柔和光斑。身穿无袖礼服裙的千花端坐在三角钢琴前，纤细指尖拂过黑白琴键。微风从敞开的窗户吹起她粉色的长发与黑色蝴蝶结发饰，平时欢脱吵闹的少女此刻全神贯注，侧脸流露出惊艳而高雅的沉静美感。
data.location: classic high school music room with grand piano and high arched windows
data.action: seated gracefully at grand piano, fingers hovering over keys, pink hair and black bow fluttering in breeze, glowing sunset, looking over shoulder with soft smile
data.lighting: intense golden sunset streaming through tall arched windows
data.mood: breathtaking musical grace, surprising aristocratic tranquility
data.promptProse: Seated at a glossy grand piano in a sun-drenched music room, Chika Fujiwara wears an elegant sleeveless recital dress. Golden sunset light illuminates her pink hair and black bow as she turns with a charming, gentle smile.
data.animaCaption: Chika sitting at a grand piano in an elegant dress as golden sunset streams through the window.
